hypothesis: Observed costs form short, medium, and long prompt groups with small within-group variation. Explicit length regimes may explain these costs better than continuous character and word-count models while retaining six distinct states.

pcvs.name: default_options
pcvs.rationale: Separates the entry state containing the exceptional initialization cost.

pcvs.expression: int(len(prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt['prompt']) > 40)
pcvs.name: longer_than_40_chars
pcvs.rationale: Separates short prompts from the medium and long prompts with substantially higher observed processing costs.

pcvs.expression: int(len(prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt['prompt']) > 100)
pcvs.name: longer_than_100_chars
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent cost increment for long prompts instead of forcing a continuous length relationship.

pcvs.expression: int((tokenization_kwargs or {}).get('add_special_tokens', True) and 'truncate_prompt_tokens' not in (tokenization_kwargs or {}))
pcvs.name: special_tokens_without_truncation
pcvs.rationale: Separates the observed additional cost when special tokens are enabled without explicit truncation.
